correctness.rationale: All labeled tournaments through order five are exhausted. Two independent Banks computations and two independent minimal-covering computations agree on every tournament. Full relabeling proves that the \(120\) strict cases form one orbit with trivial stabilizer.

value.rationale: The first separation of two canonical tournament solutions is a natural boundary already singled out by the literature. The complete threshold-layer classification reveals that the phenomenon is maximally rigid: a single alternative is always removed and every strict tournament is one relabeling orbit.
